Hi Aisha (and TalentBridge team),

Thanks again for taking time to interview with Redwood Inference. We'd like to run a compact two-day virtual loop for the Senior Infra Engineer role. To minimize context switching for interviewers and keep feedback fresh, we're proposing a "zipper" slot sequencing over two half-days (morning on Day 1, afternoon on Day 2) so panels alternate across skills and allow short debrief windows.

Proposed high-level plan:
- Day 1 (Tue, Jun 4): 09:30–12:30 PT — System design + Behavioral + Infra deep-dive (3 x 45m slots)
- Day 2 (Wed, Jun 5): 13:00–16:00 PT — Coding exercise (pairing) + Ops/Runbook + Leadership sync (3 x 45m slots)

Attached is a zipper_slot_grid_v2.xlsx with interviewer names and suggested sequencing. Can you confirm:
1) Are those two days workable?
2) Any days/times you need us to avoid?

If that looks okay, I'll loop in the interviewers and share calendar invites and a short prep doc.

Thanks — looking forward to locking this in.

Best,
Naomi Feldman
Senior Technical Recruiter
Redwood Inference

Attachment: zipper_slot_grid_v2.xlsx (interviewer matrix)
